book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Mikkina a Dlil Shilǝn i Si' Tlo Yesu
Mutti lob kǝn ɗǝ as pǝl daddaɓǝl ki ɗakǝshti ki biledi u' nǝ bǝ Yis ɗagibiwai u, I bas lǝɓasi ki Lya nǝ mi'lashti zhil ki Musa is ngau shitu u nǝ sǝ' gob Yesu ɗa u ki hwuni sǝ' tloti.
Is usu “Bǝspǝli ge' daddaɓǝl luwai, gaki ɓa mbalǝn tlǝl dlati.”
I Swati Yesu Mil mul Ulpi Abetani

Yesu a Betaniya a libi ki mulnǝ si mbeti ki Saminu dakǝl. Ti ɗamti ngu, I kǝliwon mbǝ nǝ yakǝn lǝda gunǝs pǝli nǝ zǝnga ki onis, nǝ mil a giɓi ki naldi mul ulpi. It tatl lǝda mili, it ci ndǝlli' Yesu aga.
Ginǝ a lǝbi u is kum lwetl ki mbadlǝ, is ul yelsǝni su, “Ya lak kon nǝ milu ɗa nǝgu?
Tǝ'sa ulin taka u, ngǝtl upki ndacin ki hwon nǝm as bǝlginǝ bǝ ulǝn nisi ɗawai u, da nǝn gǝtlti!” Is mati kǝli isi.
Iki i Yesu usu. “Zakǝnti, Ya laki iki hwottiti ɗa? Ulki zokki tǝpǝlini.
Ginǝ bǝ ulǝn nisiɗawai u sinekkini ko gasiukǝni. Ko gasiukǝn ki lyamtini kin pǝlissi zo'lǝɓa, gaki ko gasi u kǝn kine'kǝnwai.
I kǝliyi pǝl pǝl tiwasi. It bene mil adli it li'kǝnǝni kamin gutǝni.
Balini amipikkini, mus lu unǝ tǝ dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya tǝn dǝplǝɓa u, sin gobti dlǝb ulnǝ kǝli u pǝli u gaki da mbǝtlti.”
Yahuza Dǝgi Ti'bǝl Yesu
I Yahuza Iskalyoti, nǝm ge' mil kushtiwasi kutl nǝ lobpi, illǝma bas lǝɓasi ki Lya gaki tǝbbǝl yesu masi ɗa.
Nǝskumi nǝgu u is pǝlhwol mbatli, is ndigi sǝ'bǝlti ulpi. I' Yahuda ngwau shitu ki bǝlti.
Yesu ne Mil Kushtiwasi Ɗam Ulkiɗami Gelu Dadabǝl ki Ɗakǝshti

Cin ki nǝm ki dadabǝl ki biledi gunǝbǝ yis ɗagiɓiwai u, a kuɗi pǝtl dli i ɗǝ poshti yakǝn mbǝla gaki dadabǝl ki ɗakǝshti, i mil kushtiwas gyemti is usu, “A ukǝn ki lyamti tǝn le' likǝni' lu ɗap dadabǝl ki ɗakushti?”
I' shin mil kushtiwasi gudǝl lob, i' ulsisu, “Ten ge'gatli, kin mati nǝ mullǝn ki kami nǝ tobmal a' bǝlǝnti kali.
Ulǝn mullibi u nǝ' te giɓi usu, ‘Mul lashti ɗǝ ngau: kǝbsi nǝtǝ' dǝmi ti' ɗap ulki ɗami ki dadaɓǝl ki ɗakǝshti ne mil kushtiwasu?’
Tǝn mbokikin toh tǝnbal kǝpson ki libi ki lya, gunǝ ki likǝni ki zoki. A lǝbi ki likǝnimi.”
I' mil kushtiyi za'lǝbi, is su ge'gatli, is mbi ulisi kǝnǝ gunǝ Yesu dlǝmisi u. Is likǝn dadabǝl ki ɗakǝshti.
Nǝ bisu pǝ u, i Yesu mbǝ ne' milkushtiwas kutl nǝ lob.
Asi ɗap ulki ɗami ngu, i Yesu usu, “balini amipi'kini, nǝm agekini tin bǝltǝni, gunǝ ti ɗamti nǝ ami u.”
I mikushwasi ispǝl du'tugi, asi ultisu nǝ nǝm nǝm, “ko a mini?”
I' ulsisu, “Nǝm ge' kutl nǝ lobpi gunǝ ami ɗamti ge' gal nǝm miti.
Ya'kǝn mbalǝn nǝn zǝ'ga, kan u nǝɗa kǝlaci tǝntu. Amma ulki zǝ'go'kǝni tǝnmulnǝ nǝn bǝtl yakǝn mbalǝn u, nǝn ngǝtli' muli tǝ azǝntwai.”
Ulki ɗami ki mulban
Si ge' ɗamti, i Yasu kan biledi, nǝn ngem Lya u, iccaccali, ibbǝl mil kushti wasi, i' usu, “Kamini; guɓo dliyikǝni.”
Iki i'kan mbǝgamal, kimal ki innabi iki in ngem Lya, ibbǝlsi, muswasǝn is tle a giɓi.
“Guki hwulayini ki njikǝ' alkawali, gunǝ bǝna dli gaki mbalǝn u” i' ulsisu.
“Bali ami pikkini, akǝn tle' malki innabi nuwai, sai gasiwu nǝta tle pyale' i ge' gu'ki Lya u.”
Nǝs ulwul ki ndwa'ti Lya u, is peki is totǝn zǝga ki zaitun.
Bitlus Nǝn Nge' Ma' Yesu
I Yesu ulsisu, “Muswakǝn kǝn ndatini, ki laciɗa: ‘An li'ti mul byatl mbǝla i', mbǝla i nǝn dla'ti ga.’
Amma kal ki tlǝl lya ini, an ngǝtltikin ɗǝ mbǝkǝshti a Galili.”
I Bitlus usu, “In muswasǝn sǝn ndatu, ami akǝn ndatwai.”
I Yesu ultisu, “Bali ami dlǝmi'ki, age' gasu, kapǝn tǝ guda la'yal asǝn lop, kǝn usu kǝmanǝn wai asǝn maki.”
I Bitlus go' dlǝmti nǝndǝlti ati usu, “In nǝn tlotǝn imimiku, akǝn nge' makkiwai.” Muswasǝnma nǝgu sǝ dlǝmi.
Yesu Ngem Lya a Gatsemani
Is lǝge'luwon nǝɗǝ mbettiki Gatsemani, i' ul mil kushtiwasisu, “dǝmniki ta shilǝn nǝ Lya.”
I' kan Bitlus nǝ Yakubu, nǝ Yahaya, a ge'nǝgu i wuli gop hwottiti a mbadlwasi, i wuli tlwedli.
I' ulsisu “Mbadli ɗǝ bǝna, kǝnǝ ta mǝci. Dlilni aki, a dlilni gal.”
Nǝ' ɓeukina ten ngulen u, in nda atli, in ngem Lya, i' usu, in nǝn pǝtu akami' bǝna u taka.
I' usu, “Abba, Bwasinǝn, mus lǝɓa mul pǝkǝni amaki. Kami mbǝgamalu taka. Musnǝ nǝgu bǝ manti ki gayiwai, gwagi.”
Ippal te ma' mil kushtiwasi im mbǝsi ɗǝ nde' yemmbuɗi, i' ul Bitlus su, “Bitlus! Nde' embukǝn kiɗaya? Kǝkǝn maddǝb kǝpǝdǝliwaiya?
Dǝmni ki pǝdǝli a ngemǝn Lya, ɓa'ndan ge' cibǝlti, yalki mbatl ki lya akami i' amma dli a ndǝlwai.”
Ippal tya ɗaɗɗanu, in ngem Lya, kǝnǝ kiɗigi.
Nǝppal te'ɗu, im mbisi ɗǝ nde' yemmbuɗi, gaki yemmbu' a njikǝn dwaɗǝn wasǝn. Is hwol ulnǝ sǝ' dlǝmitu.
Patl te' ki makisi, i' ulsisu, “Kiɗi nde' yemmbuɗi aki shu'ta? Anjikǝn i! Cin ambǝ i. Yanini, sabǝl yakǝn mbalǝn a toh ɗǝ mi' pǝtl bezǝn laɓa i'.
Hillya! Mǝzǝnga! Mul bǝltǝn u ɓalu!”
A Gob Yesu i
Ti ge' shilǝn, Yahuda ngu, nǝm ge' mil kushtiwasi kutl nǝ lopi, im mbǝ ne' hwu' mbalǝn siki ngapi nǝ bas pǝga nǝ kumbǝl, bas lǝɓasi ki Lya, mi' lashti zhil ki Musa, ne' mi'kina shinsi suɗi.
Mulbǝtlti u, takǝndi nesi i, “Mulnǝ akucenttu, tiki mullisi: a'gobpǝnti, a'zǝngane'ti a'ngappǝnti kizeki.”
Nǝ mbǝkki Yahuza, I'lǝmak Yesu, I' ultisu, “mullashti!” I'kucenti.
Imbalǝni gob Yesu is ngapti nǝ ndǝlti.
Nǝm ge' milkushti ki Yesu ki dlǝli nja nǝti, in ndust pǝga wasi ittele zheli ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya nde'ti, ippa'ti kǝm.
I Yesu ulsisu, “kipe'ni ton nǝ bas pǝga nǝ kuɓǝl wakǝn ki' gobpǝnnǝn ɗama ami mǝgǝlkǝma?
Ko gasiwu kǝni amine'kini, age' libi ki Lya ami dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya, kagobnǝnwai. Pǝlǝn dli nǝgu gaki tǝ shilǝnki Lya njikǝnǝnɗa.”
Musswasǝn alǝbi is za'ti, is kitǝli.
Yakǝn giɗǝnsiwon gunǝ bǝ ulǝn nidɗa dliwai u amma ul idlatlti katl, ati bǝtl Yesu kal.
Nǝs'gob Yesu u, i' kitǝli bǝ ulǝn nidɗa dliwai, is zakkisi ul idlatti.
Yesu Akina Ɗǝ mi'Dlitl Shilǝn
Is tǝla Yesu ma' ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya, mus bas lǝɓasi, ne' mi'kina, ne' mi'lashti zhil ki Musa is domga ma'ti.
I Bitlus bǝlti kali, alolu lolu, swa dlomban ɗǝ ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya. Alǝbi iddǝm ne' mi'ɓutti dlabi, a ti ko'utu.
Bas laɓasi ne'mi'dlil shilǝn si ngau ulnǝ sǝm mbi tǝn Yesu u tǝdǝmki ta pǝl byaslǝɓayi sǝm mbi sǝ'tlotti ɗa, sa mbiwai.
Mbalǝn diɓǝli is lige'ga, biwasǝn anda nǝmwai.
A ge' kale igyen, shali Yesu lǝga'ga:
“Mǝkum ti usu, ‘Tǝn batti libi ki lya u nǝ mbalǝn kǝni nǝ toh u, a'kǝn kundu ge'mutti maki, gunǝ'bǝ kǝntiki toh wai u.’ ”
Mus nǝ nǝgu biwasǝn a nda nǝmwai.
I ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya hiliya akinawasǝn, ingem Yesu, i'ultisu, “Ulki dlimi ni'ɗawaiya? Shilǝn u nǝsi dlimti tǝnkupa?”
Yesu a shilǝn wai ta dlǝmi' ulǝnwai. I ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya ngemti ɗaɗɗanu, “Ko kiki Almasihu yakǝn ki mulnaltwa?”
Yesu usu, “Amini, kǝn ye' yakǝn mbalǝn kidǝmi tǝntohship ki mul ndǝl ki Lya, ti sussuɗi ge' kukkuti.”
I ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi kye'kyesh lulugǝllwasi. In gyemi, “Undǝ sheda ukǝn tǝn ngayin ɗaɗanu?
Ka kumǝn musǝn Lya u nǝppǝli uwaiya. Ya kiyanǝni?” Mus i mbalǝni pochi shilǝn gaki sǝ'tloti.
I gen gob bezetti makǝn, is kǝndi' dwaɗǝn, is lili'ti, si ultisu, “Dlǝmimi okǝn liki!” Mik ɓutti dlabi ki libi ki Lya is gob lilititi.
Bitlus Usu Tǝman Yesu Wai
Bitlus a atli adlomban ge' libini, I zheli Yakǝn kǝli kǝ bali ki bas lǝɓasi mbǝ.
Nǝ en Bitlus ɗiko' utu u, I' yati kizekki. I' ultisu, “Kima a yenǝnki nǝ Yesu, Banazelet tu!”
Amma i musǝn matti, i' usu, “Aman ulnǝ ki dlǝmti uwaima.” Nǝdl dlǝmi nǝgu u, i' hilya illǝbidla, alǝmdǝmtwai i guda la'yali.
I zheli yakǝn kiliyi yenti, itl dlǝmi ginǝ ki dlǝli alǝbi u, “Guma age' si tiɗa.”
Immusǝnte ɗaɗanu. Alǝn dǝmtwai, iki dlili i is ul Bitlus su, “Kima nǝmwasǝn kǝni, gaki kimul Galilini.”
I Bitlus pǝli gawas bi. Ati Lenceti, ati ussu, “Aman mulnǝ kishilǝn tǝntuwai.”
Alǝbi alǝbi i guda la'yali asǝn lob. I Bitlus dambǝl shilǝn unǝ Yesu pitu, “Kapǝn tǝgunda la'yali ki asǝn lob, kǝnmusǝnti nǝ ami asǝn maki.” Nǝ' dambǝlli u, iki immbutlgekulu.
